name: k8s datastore — the datastore filesystem is at or above 80% used
description: Fires when MAX(datastore_used_bytes / datastore_total_bytes) over the trailing 10 min is at or above 0.80. The filesystem is the tmpfs the datastore-tmpfs unit mounts at /var/lib/rancher/k3s/server/db, which holds kine's SQLite database; at 100% it refuses every write. Emitter: ci-runner/observability/ci-k3s-control-plane-telemetry.sh (1-min timer, livespec-dev-tooling-vdleg7). Receiver: the poweredge-xubuntu otel-collector (thewoolleyman/otel-collector config.ci-runner-host.yaml) -> Honeycomb env livespec. Runbook: open the 'Kubernetes workloads and control plane' board; ssh poweredge-xubuntu; kubectl get --raw='/readyz?verbose'; journalctl -u k3s --since -30min; df -h /var/lib/rancher/k3s/server/db. Compare apiserver_storage_size_bytes on the board; see plan k3s-embedded-etcd-datastore. Plan kubernetes-node-observability (livespec-dev-tooling-dfdiil), item livespec-dev-tooling-t6om4l.
